title: Step 1 - Selecting the Best Regression Model: R-squared Evaluation in Python

cues.en: Instructor: All right, my friends, are you ready for the demo?
cues.zh: 各位，準備好看示範了嗎？

cues.en: I remind that this demo works for any dataset, you know, regardless of the number of features and as long as they have, you know, the features in the first columns and then the dependent variable in the last column,
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這個示範適用任何資料集，不受特徵數量限制，只要前面是特徵，最後一欄是應變數，

cues.en: and also assuming that any missing data or categorical data was already taken care of thanks to your data preprocessing toolkit.
cues.zh: 而且已用前處理工具箱處理缺失值或類別資料。

cues.en: All right, so this is gonna be very exciting because it's really now that I'm gonna show you the power of code templates, and how you can quickly
cues.zh: 接下來很精彩，我將示範模板的力量，以及如何快速

cues.en: and efficiently select the best regression model.
cues.zh: 有效率地選出最佳迴歸模型。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this, enough talking.
cues.zh: 不多說，直接開始。

cues.en: I'm gonna proceed to the demo now, just resetting everything because we're gonna do something fun.
cues.zh: 先重新設定，因為我們要做件有趣的事。

cues.en: We will actually use this "run all" option of the run time which will run all our cells at once, so that, you know, we can really optimize the efficiency.
cues.zh: 使用 Runtime 裡的 Run All，一次執行所有儲存格，盡量提升效率。

cues.en: But let's not forget to upload the data set in each of the implementations.
cues.zh: 但別忘了在每份實作上傳資料集。

cues.en: Otherwise, this sale won't be able to execute.
cues.zh: 否則這個儲存格無法執行。

cues.en: So we're gonna upload it now, it is connecting to runtime, and in a second we should be able to see the upload button.
cues.zh: 現在上傳，正在連接執行環境，稍後會出現上傳按鈕。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: So let's click this upload button.
cues.zh: 點上傳。

cues.en: And now on your machine you're gonna find the folder, you know, the model selection folder, that's the whole machinery edit folder, and that's this new model selection folder containing,
cues.zh: 在電腦找到 Model Selection 資料夾；這是整個 Machine Learning A-Z，而這是新的模型選擇資料夾，包含

cues.en: you know, that regression folder with all the code templates for regression and the classification with all the code templates for classification.
cues.zh: 各種迴歸模板的 Regression，以及各種分類模板的 Classification。

cues.en: If you missed that folder somehow, don't worry, it was given right before this tutorial.
cues.zh: 如果錯過這個資料夾，別擔心，教學之前已提供。

cues.en: You know, in the article at the bottom you had a zip folder attached which you could download on your machine and which contains exactly the same as what I have here.
cues.zh: 文章底部附有 ZIP，可下載到電腦，內容和我這裡完全相同。

cues.en: All right? So now we're gonna go to the regression folder which contains all the implementations, meaning all the code templates for each of your regression models,
cues.zh: 進入 Regression，裡面有每個模型的實作模板，

cues.en: both in ipynb format, which you can open with either Google Colab or Jupyter Notebook, and in py format, which you can open with a classic Python terminal or Spyder in Anaconda.
cues.zh: 包含可用 Colab 或 Jupyter 開啟的 ipynb，以及可用一般 Python 終端機或 Anaconda Spyder 開啟的 py。

cues.en: So you have everything and you also have the data set, you know, containing these four features: the ambient temperature, the vacuum, the ambient pressure,
cues.zh: 所需檔案都有，也包含資料集，四個特徵是環境溫度、真空度、環境壓力，

cues.en: and the humidity, and we predict the energy output.
cues.zh: 和濕度，目標是預測能源輸出。

cues.en: All right? So that's a very classic data set.
cues.zh: 這是經典資料集。

cues.en: Once again, very generic, trying to represent the other future dataset you'll be working on.
cues.zh: 也很通用，用來代表你未來處理的其他資料。

cues.en: And while speaking of this dataset, that's exactly what we have to select here.
cues.zh: 現在就選取這個資料集。

cues.en: So we're gonna click open to upload the dataset in our notebook.
cues.zh: 點 Open，上傳到筆記本。

cues.en: And there it is.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now, as I told you here in the implementation, you only have to enter the name of your dataset.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，實作只需填入資料集名稱。

cues.en: And as far as we're concerned here for our demo, what this data set is called "data.csv", all right?
cues.zh: 這次示範的資料集叫 data.csv。

cues.en: So now we're gonna quickly do exactly the same for other implementations.
cues.zh: 現在快速對其他實作做相同處理。

cues.en: Upload then data.csv, then open and loading it, uploading it, and we'll have it in a second.
cues.zh: 點 Upload，選 data.csv，再 Open，正在上傳，稍後完成。

cues.en: And then we'll just replace the name of dataset here by data.csv.
cues.zh: 再把這裡的資料集名稱換成 data.csv。

cues.en: So that's for polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 這是多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Now, for support vector regression, well, same upload.
cues.zh: 支援向量迴歸也相同，上傳。

cues.en: Data.csv open, and loading it, uploading it.
cues.zh: 選 data.csv、Open，開始上傳。

cues.en: And in a second we should have it, there we go.
cues.zh: 稍等一下，完成了。

cues.en: Now we only replace this by data.csv.
cues.zh: 這裡也只需換成 data.csv。

cues.en: Then for decision tree regression, there we go, upload then data.csv, open, and we will have it in a second, upload it in the notebook.
cues.zh: 決策樹迴歸同樣上傳 data.csv、Open，稍後資料會載入筆記本。

cues.en: And now replacing this by data.csv.
cues.zh: 再把這裡換成 data.csv。

cues.en: And finally for random forest regression, upload data.csv, open, and now replacing this by data.csv.
cues.zh: 最後，隨機森林上傳 data.csv、Open，名稱也改成 data.csv。

cues.en: And now my friends, we are finally ready to test each of our regression models and figure out in a flashlight which one is the best.
cues.zh: 現在終於能測試每種模型，迅速找出最好的一個。

cues.en: Remember, the closer the R squared coefficient is to one, the better is your regression model.
cues.zh: 記得 R² 越接近 1，模型越好。

cues.en: So in order to figure out which is going to be the best model, we'll just take the one with the highest R squared.
cues.zh: 所以要找最佳模型，就選 R² 最高的。

cues.en: You know, with the R squared that is the closest to one.
cues.zh: 也就是最接近 1 的。

cues.en: All right, are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Starting with the multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 先從多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: So now we're simply going to go to run time and then run.
cues.zh: 到 Runtime，選 Run All。

cues.en: Oh, and all the cells are now executing.
cues.zh: 所有儲存格現在都在執行。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 結果出來了。

cues.en: We end up with an R squared coefficient of oh 0.93.
cues.zh: 最後的 R² 是 0.93。

cues.en: Very good, very good one.
cues.zh: 很好，非常好。

cues.en: As we can clearly see, you know, the predictions are amazing.
cues.zh: 可以清楚看到，預測相當出色。

cues.en: They're very close to the real results.
cues.zh: 非常接近真實結果。

cues.en: So remember, this first column is the vector of predictions and this second one is vector of real results.
cues.zh: 第一欄是預測向量，第二欄是真實結果向量。

cues.en: And that's why here we have an amazing R squared coefficient.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的 R² 很高。
